job_description:
Senior Backend Engineer

We are hiring a senior backend engineer to own our services platform. You will design and scale microservices and APIs, tune databases, and improve our cloud infrastructure.

Requirements:
- 7+ years building backend services and APIs
- Strong Python and FastAPI experience
- Deep PostgreSQL and system design skills
- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, and CI/CD
- Track record leading distributed systems work
notes: Strong backend match, senior seniority; well-structured, quantified resume closely aligned to a senior backend JD. Resume band 82-96 is the heuristic's senior tier - two roles, six bullets, eight quantified - and the strongest resume in the corpus. Match band 84-100 expects a near-complete echo of a JD written in the same stack vocabulary; the one term that stays unmatched is 'SQL', which the resume carries only inside 'PostgreSQL'.
